notes: Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale, original English wording and item scoring as published in Cox, Holden & Sagovsky (1987) — unchanged from 1.0.0, as is every option value and the item order. CHANGED IN 1.0.1: safety_response now carries real copy instead of a placeholder. It is the Stage 1 safety response verbatim, because item 10 is the same disclosure and that copy was already written and translated; the action opens the crisis hub, which holds the verified contacts, and the text contains no phone number of its own. STILL PENDING THE CLINICAL LEAD: (1) every scoring band boundary and label — the bands below are still the old placeholders, NOT EPDS cut-offs, and the cut-off validated for Ethiopian mothers may differ from the UK original; (2) all three band result texts; (3) confirmation that safety_trigger_min_value on item 10 stays at 1 (any answer other than "Never"), which is the most conservative choice; (4) the screen title, which is Sile Enat copy rather than instrument wording. The Amharic EPDS must be the validated Amharic version supplied by the clinical lead — never a translation of this file.
attribution: Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale (EPDS). Source: Cox, J.L., Holden, J.M., and Sagovsky, R. 1987. Detection of postnatal depression: Development of the 10-item Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale. British Journal of Psychiatry 150:782-786.
title: How you have been feeling
intro: As you are pregnant or have recently had a baby, we would like to know how you are feeling.
instruction: Please choose the answer that comes closest to how you have felt in the past 7 days, not just how you feel today.

items.text: I have been able to laugh and see the funny side of things

options.label: As much as I always could

items.text: I have looked forward with enjoyment to things

options.label: As much as I ever did
Rather less than I used to
Definitely less than I used to

items.text: I have blamed myself unnecessarily when things went wrong
I have been anxious or worried for no good reason
I have felt scared or panicky for no very good reason
Things have been getting on top of me

options.label: Yes, most of the time I haven't been able to cope at all
Yes, sometimes I haven't been coping as well as usual
No, most of the time I have coped quite well
No, I have been coping as well as ever

items.text: I have been so unhappy that I have had difficulty sleeping
I have felt sad or miserable
I have been so unhappy that I have been crying
The thought of harming myself has occurred to me

safety_response.title: Thank you for telling us this
safety_response.body: Thoughts like these can feel frightening and lonely, and saying so takes courage. You do not have to carry this by yourself. There are people ready to talk with you right now.
